meta.title: OpenMausBot: a request through the host
meta.subtitle: Follow a chat turn, a scheduled run, or a paired device from the client boundary to durable results.

traces.label: A person sends a chat message
A paired device reaches the host

nodes.title: Desktop shell
nodes.details:
The desktop main process starts and supervises the local server in host mode. In paired client mode, it runs a loopback relay instead of another local host.

#### Source
- [Desktop process](electron/main.mjs)
- [Server child lifecycle](electron/server-child-launch.mjs)

nodes.title: Conversation UI
nodes.details:
The browser renderer selects a session or pairing screen before mounting App. Its store sends API requests and consumes live frames; the renderer does not hold a paired-device bearer token.

#### Source
- [Session and app entry](src/main.tsx)
- [Client state](src/state/store.tsx)
- [Live frames](src/lib/live-events.ts)

nodes.title: Paired device
nodes.details:
An optional paired phone or desktop reaches a host through the companion sidecar. It checks device identity, permits only reviewed routes, and scrubs responses before forwarding to the host. It is not the unrestricted harness API.

#### Source
- [Companion listener](companion/src/index.ts)
- [Proxy](companion/src/proxy.ts)
- [Route allowlist](companion/src/routes.ts)
- [Client/host separation](docs/desktop-companion.md)

nodes.title: Request trust
nodes.details:
The HTTP boundary distinguishes authenticated sessions from loopback callers. A hosted service-trust loopback has a narrow route set; a browser on the machine is not automatically trusted as its owner. Companion clients first pass the sidecar's separate device boundary.

#### Source
- [Request authentication](server/request-auth.ts)
- [Session registry](server/sessions.ts)

nodes.title: Harness API
nodes.details:
The host composes route handlers and the live event stream. The HTTP helpers bound request bodies and serialize responses; routes operate after the request's trust and visibility checks.

#### Source
- [Host composition](server/index.ts)
- [Route table](server/routes/table.ts)
- [HTTP helpers](server/harness/http.ts)

nodes.title: Message intake
nodes.details:
The bot-message route validates the requested thread and sender, handles guarded sends and card answers, and calls the host's turn starter only when admission permits it. A send receipt can report a queued steer instead of a new turn.

#### Source
- [Message routes](server/routes/bot-messages.ts)
- [Admission](server/admission.ts)

nodes.title: Routine scheduler
nodes.details:
A saved routine selects a future occurrence or a manual run. The host dispatches its execution as a turn, records a run receipt, and reports results to the chosen conversation or the bot's main thread. A routine is not itself a separate agent engine.

#### Source
- [Schedule and run manager](server/routines.ts)
- [Execution prompt](server/routine-execution.ts)
- [Routines behavior](docs/verification/routines.md)

nodes.title: Turn host
nodes.details:
The host's startTurn entry selects the bot, thread, model and permission mode, prepares its tools, and records the turn. The same host handles person-initiated and scheduled work; it does not delegate trust decisions to model text.

#### Source
- [Turn entry](server/index.ts)
- [Turn context](server/turn-context.ts)

nodes.title: Provider registry
nodes.details:
The registry loads configured provider instances, exposes status and access, and retains a separate identity for each instance. The host chooses a configured instance before launching its driver.

#### Source
- [Provider registry](server/harness/registry.ts)
- [Driver contracts](server/contracts.ts)

nodes.title: Engine drivers
nodes.details:
Drivers adapt provider-specific sessions, prompts, permission modes and events to the host contract. The diagram does not imply every engine has the same native capabilities.

#### Source
- [CLI driver](server/drivers/claude.ts)
- [Another CLI route](server/drivers/codex.ts)
- [Pi route](server/drivers/pi.ts)

nodes.title: Tool boundary
nodes.details:
The host offers bot-scoped tools through its agents proxy; external MCP calls can pass a tool-selection and result-budget gate. A tool's availability is not permission to bypass provider or host approvals.

#### Source
- [Agents tool proxy](server/drivers/agents-proxy.ts)
- [MCP selection gate](server/mcp-gate.ts)
- [Bot tool scope](server/bot-tool-scope.ts)

nodes.title: Permission broker
nodes.details:
Provider-native permission requests reach the host's broker. It answers from the effective conversation mode or an explicit grant; missing or broken broker connections deny rather than silently allowing an action.

#### Source
- [Permission proxy](server/permission-proxy.ts)
- [Approval modes](shared/approval-mode.ts)
- [User-facing levels](docs/approval-levels.md)

nodes.title: Assignment runtime
nodes.details:
When a turn hands work to another bot, the runtime records an assignment tree, admits a free assignee, waits for terminal results or input, then resumes the requester. Ordinary single-bot chat does not require a teammate assignment.

#### Source
- [Assignment lifecycle](server/runtime/runtime.ts)
- [Host coordination adapter](server/coordinator.ts)
- [Lifecycle contract](docs/runtime-contract.md)

nodes.title: Live event bus
nodes.details:
Provider events enter a host-side bus. It batches text deltas, feeds live listeners, and appends redacted events to the thread event log. The renderer receives live frames separately from stored transcripts.

#### Source
- [Bus and log](server/harness/bus.ts)
- [Renderer live frames](src/lib/live-events.ts)

nodes.title: Bot and thread store
nodes.details:
The host store owns bot profiles and conversation tasks and projects private records into wire-safe shapes. It invokes the message database for transcript persistence; do not treat the renderer's store as the source of truth.

#### Source
- [Host store](server/store.ts)
- [Bot persistence](server/bots-save.ts)

nodes.title: Message database
nodes.details:
The host stores messages and thread state in an owner-only SQLite database. The schema also holds send receipts and notification records; a live delta is not a substitute for a persisted message.

#### Source
- [Database schema](server/message-db.ts)

nodes.title: Assignment ledger
nodes.details:
Assignment state, append-only transitions and pending wakes are committed together in runtime.db. On restart the runtime reconciles interrupted turns from these rows before dispatching work.

#### Source
- [Runtime SQLite store](server/runtime/store.ts)
- [Restart behavior](server/runtime/runtime.ts)

nodes.title: Routine records
nodes.details:
The routine manager persists definitions and run history in its validated routine file. Startup recovery reconciles interrupted scheduled work instead of interpreting a past timestamp as proof of success.

#### Source
- [Routine manager](server/routines.ts)
- [File validation](server/routine-file-validation.ts)

nodes.title: Thread event log
nodes.details:
The event bus appends redacted per-thread activity to disk with bounded queues and rotation. If a write fails, live updates may continue while the canonical event history is marked incomplete.

#### Source
- [Bus logging](server/harness/bus.ts)
- [Log rotation](server/thread-log-rotation.ts)
